excluded_lineages: its default/custom provenance, validation and create-only UI decisions
PR 255, production migration, target review and acceptance descendants

decisions.summary: Choose default versus custom workspace creation semantics.

accepted_outcomes: New Agent creation offers the Gateway-provided managed default and an explicit custom path; omission selects the managed default.
rejected_outcomes: Make custom path mandatory.
Let IM invent the owning node's default path.

decisions.summary: Choose whether workspace root can be edited after creation.

accepted_outcomes: Workspace root is immutable after Agent creation in both API and UI; later migration is a separate operation.
rejected_outcomes: Add an edit field on Agent detail.
Allow a PATCH to relocate a live Agent implicitly.

decisions.summary: Choose filesystem validation and creation rules for a custom target.

accepted_outcomes: The parent directory must already exist; the target may be absent and then be created, or may already be an ordinary directory and be accepted with a warning.
rejected_outcomes: Recursively create an arbitrary missing parent chain.
Reject every existing directory.
Accept a file as the workspace root.

decisions.summary: Choose workspace uniqueness scope across nodes.

accepted_outcomes: On one Gateway node a normalized workspace path belongs to at most one Agent; the same path string on different nodes is allowed because filesystems are independent.
rejected_outcomes: Global string uniqueness across the fleet.
Allow two Agents on one node to share the same root.

decisions.summary: Present the default/custom choice as a restrained commercial form interaction.

accepted_outcomes: Show the effective default path inline; clicking or editing the row reveals a prefilled custom path field with clear validation and warning feedback.
rejected_outcomes: Large mode cards or a demo-like default/custom chooser.
Hide the actual default path until after creation.

decisions.summary: Keep filesystem authority on the owning Gateway and treat its returned path as opaque in IM.

accepted_outcomes: IM forwards the requested path; the selected Gateway expands, normalizes, validates, creates and reserves it against its own filesystem.
rejected_outcomes: Resolve ~ or inspect parent existence on the IM host.
Import PA internals into IM.

decisions.summary: Round-trip whether the selected path is the managed default instead of re-inferring provenance on IM.

accepted_outcomes: Gateway returns a canonical workspace path plus workspace_is_default; IM persists and exposes both.
rejected_outcomes: Compare the returned path against an IM-host default.
Discard provenance and later guess it from spelling.

decisions.summary: Make reservation and profile persistence atomic enough to avoid orphaned ownership.

accepted_outcomes: The design names the Gateway operation, conflict result, compensation behavior and IM profile write so failures cannot silently allocate one path to multiple Agents.
rejected_outcomes: Frontend-only validation.
A check-then-write race with no owner or recovery.

decisions.summary: Update the complete create journey and canonical contracts without adding an edit journey.

accepted_outcomes: Deltas cover Gateway capability/default data, create operation, IM create/profile projection and desktop/mobile UI, with tests at each owner boundary.
rejected_outcomes: Only change the frontend form.
Modify the detail page into a relocation feature.

decisions.summary: Avoid speculative legacy fallback or migration scope in this creation-only feature.

accepted_outcomes: Existing Agents retain their current roots unchanged; the unit changes new creation only.
rejected_outcomes: Automatically move existing Agent directories.
Introduce a legacy-path fallback unrelated to creation.
